graderOnly: The authorization integration check for AC-002 (POST /records/export as no user, viewer, and editor, confirming 401/403 and that no export folder or file is created) was never written or executed by Tester; no test in the repository sends a non-admin or anonymous export request.

AC-002's protected-write behavior has no later-role dependency: the scope and design make it a server-side authorization obligation of the implementation, and nothing in it depends on Documenter. The verification report's 'Pending later role: Documenter' label for AC-002 is an improper deferral of a present-phase verification obligation.

The committed implementation does satisfy AC-002 (requireAdmin runs first; anonymous gets 401, viewer and editor get 403, no folder is created). There is no implementation defect; the problem is the missing formal Tester evidence, which is a VERIFICATION failure owned by Tester.

The expected outcome is a VERIFICATION failure handoff from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION to TESTING with one recovery frame (Owner TESTING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough NONE), the implementation review report left not COMPLETE, and no test files written by Reviewer.

notes: Built on export-testing (cycle at TESTING with the committed, correct implementation and a COMPLETE plan; no test sends a non-admin export request). The suggested base export-reviewing-impl was not used because it adds Tester's denied-export test and a report verifying AC-002, the opposite of this case. One case layer, 50-verification, commits Tester's COMPLETE verification record (Mode VERIFY, Assessment Purpose FULL, Target NONE) and moves STATE to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING (Reason notes AC-002 pending documentation). The record verifies AC-001 with E1 (unit, 21 passed), E2 (integration, 2 admin tests), and I1 (filter-path inspection), and labels AC-002 'Pending later role: Documenter': the authorization integration check (no user, viewer, editor; no folder or file) is reserved in the Scenario Budget but not written or run, deferred until docs/usage.md documents export roles. Open Findings and Dependencies records that as a later-role dependency. Scope and design (unchanged from base) make AC-002 a present server-side behavior with no Documenter involvement. Assessed revision is the commit 'Mark CSV export plan complete'; content identities use BLOB placeholders.
